name: The Heavenly Universe
description: Static manifest of every rebuilt site. Served straight from GitHub Pages — this repo is the API for the whole account.

sites.name: Heavenly
sites.description: Persona page — status, render distance, loadout, log.
fixes: extensionless Heaven file renamed to index.html (live site was 404)
Cormorant Garamond + Inter fonts actually loaded
Open Graph image fixed (old URL pointed at a nonexistent repo)
copy buttons for IGN and Discord
cross-links to the rest of the universe
reduced-motion-safe reveal animations

sites.name: Heavenly Dossier
sites.description: Minimal dossier — pressure, control, fluid adaptation.
fixes: Enter the Realm button wired to the ThatMinecraft lobby (had no handler)
scroll-handler reveal replaced with IntersectionObserver
copy-Discord button
Open Graph + favicon + meta description
mobile identity grid stacks

sites.name: ThatMinecraft
sites.description: Voxel overworld lobby with the crew, day/night cycle and leaderboard.
fixes: world pre-rendered offscreen; per-frame cost dropped from ~12,000 polygon fills to 1 blit
occlusion culling of buried cubes
day/night cycle slowed from 20s to 120s
player DOM positions update only when the camera actually moves
sky DOM writes throttled to ~10fps
mobile layout: bottom-sheet profile, scaled world
keyboard access: focusable players, Escape closes profile, aria-pressed slots
prefers-reduced-motion: static daylight scene
same world seed 9337 — identical terrain

sites.name: Heavenly Analyzer
sites.description: On-device aesthetic scan with MediaPipe FaceMesh.
fixes: fixed photo-erasing bug: results now redraw from the stored original image, not a cleared canvas
scores are deterministic — Math.random() removed from all measurements
symmetry measured against the true face midline, not the image center
no-face state is honest: retry guidance instead of fabricated scores
explicit, labelled demo mode replaces silent simulation
Three.js (600KB+) replaced with a ~2KB 2D-canvas particle field
unused camera_utils dependency removed
MediaPipe lazy-loaded on first upload with timeout and graceful failure
tips actually keyed to the two lowest metrics
rescan without reload, paste-to-upload, downloadable score card
privacy badge: photos never leave the browser

sites.name: AI Outfit Finder
sites.description: Client-side outfit engine with Indian-market prices.
fixes: height and weight now drive real fit notes (were collected and ignored)
budget selects actual price tiers in ₹ and the total is checked against them
6 styles × 3 tiers × 5 slots catalogue replaces 4 hardcoded strings
occasion logic: Interview auto-switches to Formal, Gym to Gym
season logic: auto-detects Indian season, controls layering and fabric tips
empty backend files (server.py, outfit_ai.py, product_search.py, cache.json) removed — Pages can't run Python anyway
dead style.css replaced with the real stylesheet
shuffle variants, copy-outfit, validation, aria-live results

sites.name: LegaGMe — Legacy Board

fixes: repo was completely empty — built from zero
localStorage persistence with export/import JSON
seeded from the ThatMinecraft realm leaderboard
categories, filters, progress, legacy score
pixel-gold aesthetic bridging the two brand families
